scenario: shared document from the head of department about revised exam timetable, sign in to view
subject: Important Update: Revised Exam Timetable
body:
Dear [Student Name],

I hope this message finds you well. We wanted to inform you that the head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering has shared an updated exam timetable that all students must review. To access this important document, please log in to your IIT Hyderabad account.

[Click here](https://portal.training.invalid/verify) to view the revised exam timetable.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

The Administration Team  
IIT Hyderabad  
@training.invalid
